limits: Emits the first arm that ran; it does not compare the arms.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Rejoins branches of a pipeline; it computes nothing.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which branch of a conditional pipeline actually ran?

description: Rejoin two branches: takes the outputs of several conditional steps and emits the first one that actually ran. This is how a two-way branch comes back together: wire both arms in, and whichever arm ran is what continues.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

fallback.description: what to emit when NO branch ran. Leave empty to make that an error instead, which is usually what you want, because silently continuing with nothing is how a pipeline reports a result it never computed.

values.description: the branches to choose between, in preference order. Wire one output from each arm.

name: pick_first

index.description: which branch it came from (0 = the first wired)

ranCount.description: how many branches produced anything. More than 1 means the conditions were not exclusive

record.description: the same value when it is a record, so it can drive a downstream $subject

value.description: the first branch that produced anything
